solyommadar11: On Day 3, Jonas Solyommadar arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions. Orders came through: Jonas Solyommadar is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a rosary of rough beads.

A bullet went through Jonas Solyommadar's sleeve at R-F5 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel of the Hegemony (@romanbhassell). Jonas Solyommadar asked to serve with the Hegemony instead of the Concord. The transfer came through: 4th Platoon, 1st Company, sector R-F3.

Fever took hold of Jonas Solyommadar overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Solyommadar. Jonas Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Jonas Solyommadar spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Solyommadar. Jonas Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
